IShellUIHelper Interface

This interface provides access to features available in the Microsoft® Windows® Shell API.

IShellUIHelper Methods

AddChannel Adds a new channel to the list of channels.
AddDesktopComponent Adds an item to the Active Desktop™.
AddFavorite Displays the default user interface for creating a favorite, which is initialized using the specified parameters.
AutoCompleteSaveForm Saves a specified form to AutoComplete data storage.
ImportExportFavorites Handles the importing and exporting of Microsoft® Internet Explorer favorites.
IsSubscribed Verifies if the user is subscribed to the specified URL.
NavigateAndFind Navigates to the specified URL and selects the specified text.
ShowBrowserUI Invokes the browser UI.

Interface Information

Implementation ShellUIHelper Object
Inherits from IUnknown
Header and IDL files Exdisp.h; Exdisp.idl
Minimum availability Internet Explorer 4.0, 5 (for NavigateAndFind & ImportExportFavorites)
Minimum operating systems Windows 95; Windows NT 4.0
